## What changes

Describe the problem and the resulting behaviour. Link the related issue, if
there is one.

## Validation

List the checks you ran (`just check-changed`, `just lint`, device flows) and
their results. Add screenshots for visible changes, and say which platform or
integration checks you could not run.

## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Tests cover the change, or the description explains why none are needed.
- [ ] Generated files are up to date (`just generate`; the CLI reference after help changes).
- [ ] User docs (`site/content/docs`) and contributor docs (`docs/`) match the change.
- [ ] No credentials, private transcripts or personal data in code, fixtures or screenshots.
